test_index_union_non_numeric: test the Index.union method to combine numeric and non-numeric indexes with correct dtype promotion
test_index_intersection: test the Index.intersection method to find common elements between two integer indexes
test_index_int_float_union_dtype: test that union of integer and float indexes promotes to float64 dtype
test_index_difference: test the Index.difference method to return elements in float index not present in string index
test_index_symmetric_difference: test the Index.symmetric_difference method to find elements unique to each of two indexes
